meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card: what will happen, the folder, how many files and how much space, that it cannot be undone, a way to see the first few file names, and approve and deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision and locks.
meta.text:
state folder="Shared drive/Archive (over 2 years old)"
state space="1.8 GB"
state decision=""
state preview="no"
Card w:390 gap:12 pad:16
  Text.heading "Approve file deletion?"
  Text "This will permanently delete 214 files ({space}) from {folder}."
  Text.danger "This cannot be undone. Deleted files cannot be recovered."
  if decision==""
    Button.ghost "Show first 3 file names" -> preview="yes"
  if preview=="yes"
    Column gap:4
      Text.small "2019_Q1_budget_draft.xlsx"
      Text.small "client_meeting_notes_2019.docx"
      Text.small "site_photos_march_2019.zip"
  if decision==""
    Row gap:8
      Button.destructive "Approve" -> decision="Approved"; emit approve_delete
      Button.outline "Deny" -> decision="Denied"; emit deny_delete
  if decision!=""
    Text.strong "Decision: {decision}"
